rendering: Exact original compiled MJB models and recorded qpos/ctrl/mocap state replay with mj_forward only; no mj_step, no state interpolation. Context and tracking closeup are views of the same recorded state.
start_policy: Native pregrasp +100mm worldZ, no-hand-contact visible pause0.5s, vertical approach2s, then original close/squeeze, loaded hold1s, lift100mm5s, hold5s, release.
